common.tagline: Map-based cost estimating for Canadian public infrastructure
common.sampleDataNotice: All prices and reference data are illustrative sample values, not real cost data.

landing.title: Estimate public infrastructure on a map
landing.intro: Describe what you want to build, lay it out on a map, and get a transparent cost range with risks and drivers.
landing.promptPlaceholder: e.g. A two-storey 2,400 m² library, a 1.5 ha park with a splash pad, and 400 m of new road
landing.example1: A two-storey library, a neighbourhood park, and a 400 m road
landing.example2: 3 townhouse blocks, a low-rise apartment and a 1 ha park
landing.example3: A fire station and a culvert replacement
landing.nothingFound: No roads, parks, buildings or structures found in that description. Try naming them, or start with a blank map.
landing.sampleBody: Two roads, a park, a branch library, a fire station and a culvert, with an estimate. Sample data.

map.panelPlaceholder: The estimate will appear here once components are drawn.
map.loadError: The map could not load. Check your connection; everything else still works.

search.label: Search for a municipality or address
search.error: Search is unavailable right now. Pan the map instead.

views.label: View
views.issuesHint: Highlight on the map what the flags are about: buildings in the way, creeks, rail, schools and hospitals nearby

map.rotateMode: Rotate mode: drag on the map to turn it (and tilt it in the 3D map)
map.rotateHint: Drag left or right to turn the map. Click the rotate button or press Esc when done.
map.rotateHint3d: Drag left or right to turn, up or down to tilt. Click the rotate button or press Esc when done.

zoning.title: Zoning (Waterloo)
zoning.noData: No zoning data here. The zoning layer covers the City of Waterloo only.
zoning.source: City of Waterloo Zoning By-law 2018-050 zone map, snapshot. Advisory: may lag recent amendments; not a legal zoning determination. Click a zone for its code.

components.title: Components
components.empty: No components yet. Draw one with the tools on the map, or load the sample project.
components.newProjectConfirm: Start a new project? The current design will be cleared. Download the project file first if you want to keep it.
components.plannedHint: {n, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} still to place. Find the location with search, then Generate a starting layout (✨ above), or select one and draw it.

tools.smart: Smart start: click the map to drop a typical shape
tools.snap: Snap to streets (route along the street network)

hints.polygon: Click to add corners. Click the first corner again to finish.
hints.rectangle: Click one corner, then the opposite corner.
hints.circle: Click the centre, then click again to set the size.
hints.ellipse: Click the centre, then click again to set the size.
hints.freehand: Click to start, move to draw, and click again to finish.
hints.line: Click to add points. Click the last point again to finish.
hints.freehandLine: Click to start, move to draw, and click again to finish.
hints.smart: Click the map to place a typical starting shape, facing the nearest street.
hints.smartShort: Click the map where it goes. It faces the nearest street; reshape it after.

notices.holeOutside: That hole wasn’t added: draw it inside the shape, clear of other holes.

draw.noMatches: Nothing matches. Try “Custom element” under Other.
draw.pickerHint: Buildings, parks, lots and structures drop at a typical size with one click; reshape them after. Roads and custom elements are drawn.

edit.label: Edit “{name}”
edit.hint: Drag a shape to move it, or its points to reshape it. Drag a midpoint to add a point; right-click a point to remove it. Use the handles to move, rotate, or resize everything (Shift keeps proportions).

inspector.mergeFailed: These sections don't touch, so they can't be merged into one shape.
inspector.warningsTitle: {n, plural, one {# design warning} other {# design warnings}}

warnings.featureOutside: A feature of “{name}” is outside the park.
warnings.tallBuilding: “{name}” has {storeys} storeys, unusual for this type.
warnings.longRoad: “{name}” is {km} km long. Is that intended?

estimate.title: Estimated cost (P50)
estimate.empty: Draw a road, park, building, or structure to see its estimated cost.
estimate.undrawn: {count, plural, one {# planned component isn't drawn yet} other {# planned components aren't drawn yet}} and adds no cost.
estimate.componentNote: Component figures come from the same simulation and don't add up to the project total.
estimate.improveHeading: To narrow the range, fill in (click to go to the input):
estimate.overrunTypical: Similar projects typically run {pct}% over budget
estimate.flagShowOnMap: Show on the map (click again to clear)
estimate.p50Note: P50: as likely to come in under as over
estimate.durationRange: Likely {low}–{high} months. Sets escalation to the construction midpoint and winter work.

site.label: 3D site scene of the project
site.empty: Draw or generate components to see them in 3D.
site.hint: Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Click to select.

buildList.fallbackNote: AI assistant unavailable, so this list comes from keyword matching. Check it before continuing.
buildList.heading: {count, plural, =0 {Build list} one {Build list (# component)} other {Build list (# components)}}
buildList.empty: No components yet. Add one to continue.
buildList.name: Component name

lineItems.empty: No line items for this scope yet.
lineItems.note: Edit a quantity or unit price to override it. Overrides replace the calculated value and are marked; reset to go back.

projectFile.replaceConfirm: Opening a project file replaces the current project. Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?

errors.too_large: That file is too large to be a project file.
errors.invalid_json: That file isn't a PublicWorks Cost project file (it isn't valid JSON).
errors.not_project: That file isn't a PublicWorks Cost project file.
errors.newer_version: This project file was made with a newer version of the app (file version {detail}) and can't be opened here.
errors.invalid: This project file is damaged or incomplete and can't be opened. Details: {detail}

inputs.none: This component has no inputs; it's priced from its drawn size and rate.

customPricing.chooseBasis: Choose what this is most like…
customPricing.matchedNote: Priced per {unit} of the drawn shape, with a wider range (−30% / +60%) because it's a match, not a quote.
customPricing.bandError: Low must be at or below the rate, and high at or above it.
customPricing.ownNote: Without low/high, the range is −30% / +60% of your rate. Your rate is marked as user-entered.

charts.byComponentLabel: P50 by component. Select one to see its own estimate.
charts.byComponentHint: Click a bar to open that component
charts.distributionLabel: Simulated project cost: P10 {p10}, P50 {p50}, P90 {p90}
charts.distributionNote: 5,000 simulated outcomes. The shaded middle is the likely range (P10–P90).
charts.byCategoryNote: Direct construction cost by category, before soft costs, escalation and taxes.

evidence.title: Market evidence
evidence.buildingNote: Building only, comparable to Altus. All-in with site works, parking and extras: {allIn}/sq ft.
evidence.roadNote: All-in per metre of road. Altus covers road servicing for development; our scope may add watermains and sewers.
evidence.trend: Statistics Canada: prices for {type} in {geo} changed {change} over the last 4 quarters.
evidence.trendFlat: Statistics Canada: prices for {type} in {geo} were flat over the last 4 quarters.
evidence.footnote: Sources: Altus Group 2026 Canadian Cost Guide (retrieved {altusDate}), Statistics Canada table 18-10-0289-01 (released {statcanDate}), CanadaBuys award notices (retrieved {canadabuysDate}). Evidence informs judgement; it doesn't change the estimate.
